description: Discovered taxonomy for personal knowledge library

categories.name: primary
categories.description: Core topic or entity that defines what the resource is about
rules: Use the most specific term available
Prefer compound terms over single words

categories.name: contextual
categories.description: Format, intent, or situational context of the resource
rules: Describe what the content IS, not what it's about

categories.name: style
categories.description: Aesthetic or tonal vibe of the content
rules: Exactly one style tag per card
Choose the most visually dominant trait

platform_guidelines.twitter: Focus on ideas and discourse, not the platform itself
platform_guidelines.instagram: Focus on visual aesthetics and the creator
platform_guidelines.github: Focus on tech stack and tools
platform_guidelines.youtube: Focus on creator, format, and subject
platform_guidelines.general: Focus on core subject and key entities
